# Pipeline V1 pre-activation checklist

Status: prepared for review; not activated.

This checklist is operational only. It stops before migration application and provider execution. `PIPELINE_V1_ENABLED` remains false.

## Diff classification

### Required for Pipeline V1 activation

- `src/pipeline/config.mjs`, `src/pipeline/feature-flags.mjs`, `src/pipeline/codex-adapter.mjs`, `src/pipeline/codex-writer.mjs`, `src/pipeline/pitch.mjs`.

The committed legacy candidate path and tests are present, including the Ollama adapter, legacy orchestrator, schemas, synthesis, workflow, and legacy pipeline tests. Do not remove them in the activation commit.

### Generated artifacts

- `public/app.js` is the client bundle. Its generated trailing whitespace was normalized after the client build.
- `/Volumes/External/GitHub/IGNORED/anyways-controller/dist/` is generated by the controller TypeScript build. Include only the build output corresponding to the reviewed controller source.

### Benchmark and holdout only

The existing dirty `pipeline-benchmark/**`, `PIPELINE_V1_HOLDOUT.md`, `docs/FROZEN_BENCHMARK_CONTROLLER.md`, `bin/final-discovery-benchmark.mjs`, and holdout/frozen result artifacts are not activation changes. Preserve them, but exclude them from the activation commit.

### Unrelated or accidental changes to exclude

The current checkout also contains pre-existing changes in `.DS_Store`, broad README/package housekeeping, `bin/pipeline-sync-supabase.mjs`, `src/newsroom-pipeline.mjs`, `src/pipeline/state.mjs`, unrelated legacy tests, `ENGINEERING_SUMMARY.md`, and other benchmark/holdout files. They were not used to authorize V1 activation and should be excluded pending a separate review.

The controller checkout is an unborn working tree. Establishing its baseline is separate from this V1 activation diff; do not include `.env`, `supabase/.temp`, or local logs.

## Migration gate

- [ ] Review the exact order in `PIPELINE_V1_MIGRATION_RUNBOOK.md`.
- [ ] Take the normal production database backup.
- [ ] Confirm the linked migration inventory still shows the five files as local-only:

```sh
cd /Volumes/External/GitHub/IGNORED/anyways
supabase migration list --linked
```

- [ ] Apply only after review, backup, and controller drain:

```sh
cd /Volumes/External/GitHub/IGNORED/anyways
supabase db push --linked
```

- [ ] Verify RPCs and columns after application without submitting a job.
- [ ] Do not run either command during this preparation task.

## Environment gate

- [x] `PIPELINE_V1_ENABLED=false` and `PIPELINE_V1_ALLOWED_JOB_ID=` are documented in both `.env.example` files; the current controller `.env` leaves both unset, so the default is false and no scoped job is allowed.
- [x] Exact Luna, Terra, Draft, and Sol model/reasoning defaults are documented in `/Volumes/External/GitHub/IGNORED/anyways/.env.example`.
- [x] `PHASE2_JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=2400` is documented in the controller `.env.example` and is the code default.
- [x] Codex authentication uses `ANYWAYS_CODEX_AUTH_FILE`, defaulting to the isolated Codex auth route when unset.
- [x] Credit-to-USD is documented as optional `ANYWAYS_CODEX_CREDIT_USD`; null is valid when unset.
- [x] Supabase URL, anon key, and service-role key are documented as placeholders in the Anyways `.env.example`; controller URL and service-role key are documented separately.
- [ ] Set production values only during the authorized activation task. Secret values must not be printed.

Restart command for the next operational task, not for this task:

```sh
cd /Volumes/External/GitHub/IGNORED/anyways-controller
npm run build
npm run launchd -- restart
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:4317/health
```

## Activation gate

- [ ] Complete `PIPELINE_V1_CONTROLLED_SMOKE_TEST.md` with one approved low-risk story.
- [ ] Keep the global flag false until migrations, deployment, restart, and health checks pass.
- [ ] Set `PIPELINE_V1_ALLOWED_JOB_ID` only to the exact smoke-test job ID; do not enable V1 globally for ordinary queue traffic.
- [ ] Stop before publication.
- [ ] Clear `PIPELINE_V1_ALLOWED_JOB_ID` and verify an unversioned legacy job remains routed to the fallback.

## Current blockers

- The five migrations are unapplied.
- The controller artifact is not deployed and the controller has not been restarted.
- The linked environment is not configured for an activation run: explicit production model variables and `PIPELINE_V1_ENABLED` are not present in the current local environment files, and therefore code defaults apply.
- Local PostgreSQL was unavailable for migration lint (`LegacyDbConnectError`); static validation passed, but isolated database validation remains pending.
- The immutable benchmark validator intentionally rejects the working controller tree because it differs from the historical frozen snapshot. See `PIPELINE_V1_BENCHMARK_DRIFT_NOTE.md`.
